roleCodePattern: Start with a lowercase letter; use 3-32 lowercase letters, digits, or underscores
permissionCodePattern: Start with a lowercase letter; separate segments with colons; digits and underscores allowed
paramKeyPattern: Lowercase dot-separated segments; each segment starts with a letter; digits and underscores allowed

param.bool: Boolean values must be true or false
param.intRange: Value is outside the 64-bit integer range
